# Absolutely Lucy

> > A solo female travel blog featuring budget backpacking guides, digital nomad resources, and adventure stories from Australia, Europe, Asia, and beyond.

Absolutely Lucy is written by Lucy, a UK-based travel blogger sharing practical advice for solo travelers, backpackers, and digital nomads. The site covers destination guides, money-saving tips, packing essentials, and personal stories from adventures across Australia, Portugal, Sri Lanka, Thailand, and other global destinations.

## Key Topics

- Solo travel
- Budget backpacking
- Female solo travel
- Australia travel (Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane)
- Digital nomad visas
- Travel blogging monetization
- European hiking destinations
- Portugal (Pico Island, Azores)
- Sri Lanka itineraries
- Travel gear and packing essentials
- Long-term travel
- Travel confidence and overcoming fear
- Camping and national parks
- Travel on a budget
- UK citizens abroad

## Essential Travel Guides

- [Ultimate Guide To Digital Nomad Visas For UK Citizens](https://absolutelylucy.com/digital-nomad-visas-uk-citizens): Comprehensive guide to digital nomad visa options for UK citizens
- [Ultimate Sri Lanka 2 week itinerary from Colombo](https://absolutelylucy.com/sri-lanka-2-week-itinerary): Complete 2-week Sri Lanka itinerary from Colombo with costs and routes
- [The Ultimate Guide to Visiting Sydney, Australia](https://absolutelylucy.com/guide-visiting-sydney-australia): Complete Sydney guide for budget travelers and backpackers
- [11 Ways To Make Money From Travel Blogging in 2025](https://absolutelylucy.com/make-money-travel-blogging): Travel blog monetization strategies including Mediavine and affiliates
- [Pico Island Azores – The Most Underrated Island in Portugal](https://absolutelylucy.com/pico-island-azores-portugal): Complete Pico Island guide: hiking, whale watching, wine tours, and hotels
- [10 Best Destinations for Solo Hikers in Europe](https://absolutelylucy.com/destinations-solo-hikers-europe): Top 10 European solo hiking destinations including Portugal and Montenegro
- [My ultimate guide to planning your New York city breaks](https://absolutelylucy.com/new-york-city-breaks): NYC city break planning guide covering flights, accommodation, and sights
